detail.title: Riser 40 360° Rotating Carbon Steel Laptop Stand - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Riser 40 is a carbon steel laptop stand with a 360-degree rotating base, letting you turn a laptop or tablet freely to face any direction without repositioning the whole stand. Height and viewing angle are both adjustable, so it can be dialled in to suit different desk heights and seating positions, while a cooling ventilation design improves airflow underneath the device to help manage heat during longer sessions. Anti-slip silicone pads keep laptops and tablets securely in place, and the sturdy steel body supports laptops and MacBooks comfortably without wobbling, making it a reliable ergonomic upgrade for any desk.
